outcome: practice of healthy nutritional habits during pregnancy
cohort: 135 pregnant women attending the Zagazig university antenatal care clinic
finding: The nutritional health education program effectively improved pregnant women's knowledge, attitude, and practice towards healthy nutrition during pregnancy, leading to optimal weight gain and improved maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was a statistically significant higher rate of cesarean section in the overweight group compared to the optimal weight gain group.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight was measured, and higher neonatal weights were found in the overweight versus optimal weight gain group.
